entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these ridiculous shoes I bought. They're complete garbage and I want my money back immediately.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Mike Peterson, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. And don't give me a runaround, I've had these things for over a month and they're useless.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. I understand you're unhappy with them, but what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
What's the issue? The issue is they're horribly designed! I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, and all I got for my trouble were massive blisters on both heels. They're unwearable!
I see. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can understand your frustration.

You're damn right it's frustrating! I'm not paying for something that injures me. I want a full refund, and if you try to deny it, I'll be speaking to your manager and posting reviews about your terrible products on every cycling forum online.
I understand your position, and there's no need to speak with a manager. I can handle this for you right now. Let me just confirm the purchase date... Okay, I see the order was delivered 38 days ago.
Yeah, so? Are you going to try and tell me I'm out of luck?

Not at all. Our return policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is 10 days from the date of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh. So... you'll give me a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You will receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment.
Okay. A full refund, you said? No restocking fees or any of that nonsense?
That's correct, a full refund with no fees. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mike?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
